summary: Cloud speech-to-text via AssemblyAI, routed through Subtitld Cloud. High accuracy with speaker diarization; needs a Subtitld Cloud API key and an internet connection.
author: Subtitld

fields.label: Subtitld Cloud API key
fields.description: Your Subtitld Cloud key — NOT an AssemblyAI key. Generate one at https://cloud.subtitld.org/dashboard/keys/. Shared with the other cloud-backed providers, so you only paste it once.

fields.label: Model

options.label: Nano — faster and cheaper, more languages

fields.description: Which AssemblyAI tier to use. The authoritative list lives at /api/v1/catalog?provider=assemblyai — if a model here is rejected as unknown, refresh the catalog from the Subtitld Cloud dashboard.

fields.label: Detect speakers (diarization)
fields.description: Label each cue with the speaker who said it. Adds a little processing time upstream.

fields.label: One cue per sentence
fields.description: On: one subtitle per sentence, as segmented by AssemblyAI. Off: one subtitle per speaker turn (longer cues). Has no effect when the server returns only speaker turns.

fields.label: Cloud endpoint
fields.description: Advanced — leave empty to use https://cloud.subtitld.org. Set this only to point at a draft or self-hosted Subtitld Cloud server.
